articles.summary: Teya, one of Europe's fastest-growing acquirers, partnered with Diligent to remove manual proof of business checks from onboarding with AI agents. Within a year, straight-through onboarding trebled, manual review queues halved and the team saved 18,000 hours annually. Teya is now on track to hit its ambitious automation targets without adding headcount.
articles.title: How Teya tripled straight-through processing in customer onboarding with AI agents
